component_definitions.DuplexProducer: Wall-clock duration of one duplex frame producer tick.
component_definitions.ExecutiveTick: Wall-clock duration of one non-LLM task-executive tick.
component_definitions.FillerLatency: End of final user input to the first audible duplex filler utterance (playback start / TTS enqueue audible — not filler fire time).
component_definitions.IntentRouter: Wall-clock duration of deterministic intent routing.
component_definitions.ObservationSnapshotBuild: Wall-clock duration of building a bounded camera/LiDAR planning snapshot.
component_definitions.PlanAcceptance: Wall-clock duration of task-executive plan admission.
component_definitions.PlanModel: Wall-clock duration of the complete planning-model request.
component_definitions.PlanValidation: Wall-clock duration of PlanIR validation against fresh state.

definitions.AcousticAck: The end-to-end acknowledgement budget: last owner speech frame to the instant the speaker worker began writing the first reply chunk. This is the number a sub-700 ms ack claim has to beat.
definitions.EndpointDecision: Last speech frame of the owner's utterance to the endpointer's commit decision (how long the robot deliberated before deciding they stopped).
definitions.IntentRouting: End of final user input to production of IntentFrame.
definitions.ObservationSnapshotBuild: IntentFrame production to completion of the bounded planning observation snapshot.
definitions.PlanAcceptance: Successful plan validation to task-executive admission.
definitions.PlanDecode: Observation snapshot completion to receipt and parsing of the complete PlanIR.
definitions.PlanTimeToFirstOutput: Observation snapshot completion to the first planning-model output token; for a non-streaming provider, the complete parsed planning response.
definitions.PlanValidation: Complete PlanIR parsing to successful plan validation.
definitions.PlaybackEnqueueToFirstSample: Audio-sink handoff to the speaker worker starting that chunk. The acoustic rig measured 0.54-0.64 s here, so it may never be assumed 0.
definitions.QueryEndToFirstSpokenAudio: End of final user input to the first audio-sink handoff. This is a software lower-bound estimate until acoustic presentation timestamps are available.
definitions.SttFinalToQueryEnd: Final transcript to the turn's query-end anchor (session admission).
definitions.SttRequestQueue: Endpointer commit to the start of the STT request (segmentation, WAV framing and dispatch overhead).
definitions.SttTranscribe: STT request start to the final transcript.
definitions.UserQueryEndToAcceptedPlan: End of final user input to admission of a validated plan by the task executive.
definitions.UserQueryEndToFirstPlanOutput: End of final user input to the first planning-model output token; for a non-streaming provider, the complete parsed planning response.
definitions.UserQueryEndToFirstReasoningResponse: End of final user input to the first model output token; for deterministic or non-streaming paths, the complete validated reasoning result.
definitions.UserQueryEndToFirstResponse: End of final user input to the first response made observable by logging or audio playback, whichever occurs first.

stage_definitions.intent_routed: The deterministic intent router has classified the final user turn and produced its versioned IntentFrame.
stage_definitions.observation_snapshot: A bounded, sensor-grounded ObservationSnapshot is ready for planning.
stage_definitions.plan_accepted: The validated plan has been admitted by the task executive for execution.
stage_definitions.plan_first_output: The first output token or equivalent partial output from the planning model.
stage_definitions.plan_response: The complete planning-model response has been received and parsed as PlanIR.
stage_definitions.plan_validated: PlanIR has passed schema, semantic, capability, freshness, and safety validation.
